## 8. Electronic acceptance and records

Posting the exact acceptance statement supplied by the repository's CLA check

intent to be legally bound. Do not authorize a bot or another person to sign

Your public GitHub account identifier and username, acceptance statement,

Do not put an address, private email, identity document, or confidential employer

and resolve related disputes. Removing a comment or changing your username does
